company.name: Kisstixx
company.one_liner: Lip balm made for kissing: two flavors that react when they meet.

facts.summary: Two friends sell pairs of lip balms with flavors designed to combine when two people kiss. They're aiming at gift shops, college students and big drugstore chains.
highlights: Each pack has two matching flavors that mix when people kiss.
It's a fun, giftable impulse product that's cheap to make.
The founders say big retailers are interested.
Lip balm is a crowded category full of big brands.

real_deal.summary: Mark Cuban invested $200,000 for 40% of the company (a $500K value).

outcome.headline: Sales faded after the TV buzz, and the company shut down in 2018.
outcome.story: Kisstixx had a burst of sales after the episode, but a claimed big-retailer deal turned out to be paperwork, not a real order, and sales slowed once the buzz wore off. The business closed in 2018.
